LanguageData.MST.weaponCategoryComment: Only weapons of this WeaponCategoryDef can roll the trait (vanilla: BladeLink / Gun / Bow / BulletFiring …). Only affects weapons generated afterwards.
LanguageData.MST.canGenerateAloneComment: When off, the trait is only rolled if the weapon already has another trait (used for "attachment"/"suffix" style traits). Only affects weapons generated afterwards.
LanguageData.MST.exclusionTagsComment: Mutual-exclusion tags: two traits sharing any tag never appear on the same weapon.
LanguageData.MST.traitAdjectivesComment: Adjectives used when naming generated weapons ("kind assault rifle"). Only affects naming of weapons generated afterwards.
LanguageData.MST.forcedColorComment: Color forced onto the weapon when it is generated. Already-generated weapons store their color in their own comp, so this does not apply retroactively.
LanguageData.MST.damageDefOverrideComment: Replaces the weapon's damage type entirely (incendiary/EMP rounds do it this way). Empty = no override.
LanguageData.MST.extraDamagesComment: Additional damage dealt on hit; each entry rolls its own chance independently. Stacks with the damage-type override.
LanguageData.MST.extraDamageAmountComment: Extra damage dealt by this entry per hit.
LanguageData.MST.extraDamageArmorPenetrationComment: Armor penetration of this entry. -1 means "derive it from the damage amount" (vanilla default).
LanguageData.MST.extraDamageChanceComment: Chance for this entry to trigger per hit. 1 = always, 0.5 = half the time.
LanguageData.MST.additionalStoppingPowerComment: Added to the weapon's stopping power (impact/knockback). Additive.
LanguageData.MST.burstShotSpeedMultiplierComment: Divisor for the interval between shots in a burst: 1.2 = interval / 1.2 (faster), below 1 = slower. Does not change burst length.
LanguageData.MST.burstShotCountMultiplierComment: Multiplier on shots per burst: 1.5 = half again as many per burst (rounded up). 1 = unchanged.
LanguageData.MST.ignoresAccuracyMalusesComment: When on, the weapon's own accuracy maluses (bad sights, sawn-off barrel…) no longer reduce its hit chance.
LanguageData.MST.marketValueOffsetComment: Silver added to / subtracted from the market value of a weapon with this trait (read live by StatPart_WeaponTraitsMarketValueOffset).
LanguageData.MST.bondedThoughtComment: Situational thought granted while the weapon is bonded to the pawn (this is how persona "kind"/"bloodthirsty" works).
LanguageData.MST.killThoughtComment: Thought granted after killing someone with this weapon.
LanguageData.MST.equippedHediffsComment: Hediffs applied while the weapon is equipped; removed when unequipped.
LanguageData.MST.bondedHediffsComment: Hediffs applied once the weapon is bonded to the pawn; removed when the bond breaks.
LanguageData.MST.neverBondComment: When on, the weapon never bonds with a pawn (pairs with the NeverBond exclusion tag).
